name: Sorsogon Kasanggayahan Marathon 2026
short_description: A 42.195km full marathon in Sorsogon City, Philippines, taking place on October 18, 2026 at the Sorsogon Sports Arena.
ai_summary: The Sorsogon Kasanggayahan Marathon 2026 is a full marathon covering 42.195 kilometers, scheduled for October 18, 2026 in Sorsogon City, Philippines. The race starts and is based at the Sorsogon Sports Arena and is organized by Off Ground Events. Registration details have not yet been announced, so prospective runners should check back for updates on sign-up.
pros: Standard full marathon distance of 42.195km for serious distance runners
Held at a dedicated venue, the Sorsogon Sports Arena, in Sorsogon City
Organized by a named event organizer, Off Ground Events
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so sign-up details are unavailable
No pricing, route, or field-size information has been provided yet
research_highlights: The 2026 edition offers four distances: 42KM, 21KM, 10KM, and 5KM, based at Sorsogon Sports Arena.
Registration fees are listed as ₱2,400 (42K), ₱1,800 (21K), ₱1,000 (10K), and ₱950 (5K).
The race is timed to coincide with the Kasanggayahan Festival, described by the organizer as "a festival running experience celebrating health, fitness, sports tourism, and the culture of Sorsogon".

The Kasanggayahan Festival period (mid-to-late October) in Sorsogon includes parades, concerts, and cultural performances happening around the same dates as the race, so runners can expect a festival atmosphere and possible road/event congestion in the city during race week.

This is a newer event on the Off Ground Events calendar; the Sorsogon Sports Arena venue has also hosted other local races such as the Ciudad De Sorsogon Marathon and the National Milo Marathon's Sorsogon leg, which has drawn around 10,000 runners in recent years.

faqs.answer: The Sorsogon Kasanggayahan Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on October 18, 2026. faqs.question: What distance is the Sorsogon Kasanggayahan Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Sorsogon Kasanggayahan Marathon is a full marathon with a primary distance of 42.195 kilometers, the standard internationally recognized marathon distance. This is the only distance listed for the event, making it geared toward runners specifically training for or seeking a full marathon challenge.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race is held at the Sorsogon Sports Arena in Sorsogon City, Philippines. Sorsogon City serves as the host city for the entire event, and the Sports Arena functions as the venue tied to the marathon, organized by Off Ground Events.
